newsitem.title: ITALY: Maximum rate 8.3 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.
newsitem.headline: Maximum rate 8.3 pct at Italy lira reverse repo.

text.p: The maximum rate at today's 14.0 trillion lire two-day Bank of Italy reverse repurchase tender was 8.30 percent, compared with 8.61 at the previous reverse repo tender, the Bank said.
The average rate was 8.10 percent against 8.59 percent at the last repurchase pact for 4.5 trillion lire and six days on October 17.
The pact takes effect today and the securities are for resale on November 6. The Bank said it received 40 bids of which 27 were met in full and five in part.
